# A practical vocabulary review policy

Ask the learner to produce a word from a meaning and context before displaying the answer. Record an unaided response as success; recognition after revealing it is an error for this exercise. After success increase the interval, and after failure shorten it while checking whether the prompt was ambiguous.

Keep a daily workload ceiling and review persistent failures for multiple senses or missing examples. A card can be suspended and rewritten instead of drilled indefinitely. The policy combines the retrieval task with scheduling, so neither a long streak nor rapid clicking is the sole measure of learning.
